label: consistent

said.text: I am glad that we finally have a process in place to permanently establish Cannabis Showcase Event permits in state law. This will expand market opportunities for smaller farmers and processors, allowing them to grow their consumer base.
said.sourceName: Office of Assemblymember Lupardo press release (via Morning Ag Clips)

did.text: Voted Yes on S10113, which lets a cannabis microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales also serve as the processor and cultivator for a cannabis showcase event permit. Passed Assembly 88–53.

whyNote: The 2025 statement welcomed the law that created cannabis showcase event permits, saying they would expand market opportunities for smaller farmers and processors; the 2026 vote broadened the role microbusinesses may play in those events. Lupardo sponsors the Assembly companion (A11217). The statement predates this bill and concerns the underlying showcase-permit law.
